english: Behind the bars you see a very, very fancy warhammer.
Made out of Adamantium. Which means it's functionally useless.
You also see a bag of 'Griffon Fodder Goodies' - quite the expensive treat. Niche too.
Appears to be almost one hundred percent meat. You could reach it easily.
Stick your hand between the bars to reach it.
Lift the bars to get it.
Reaching in between the bars, you easily scoop up a handful of the stinky little nuggets and toss them into your Pouch of Holding.
Let us wish, for the sake of everything, that these nasty bits won't stink up all your other stuff.

This isn't even an item. It's just mush. You're pushing mush into the pouch. This does NOT count as loot in any shape, way, or form. You refuse to consider this loot, in ANY way. This MUSH is NOT loot. You will NOT be able to find it in your inventory. It is ANTI-LOOT.
But everything else I get counts as loot?
Now stop thinking about the mush.
Adamantium is extremely light as a crafting material.
Making a warhammer out of it is idiotic.
Whoever made it, did it either as a testament to their wealth, or their foolishness.
You know you can do this!
You try to slip on through, but... No.
Nothing you do allows you to reach far enough. Not breathing in... not pushing harder...
You'll need to try something else.
You get ready in a stance, squatting down.
As you push it upwards, you hear the iron grinding.
Raising your body, pushing your muscles to the limit - you manage to actually STAND UP.
The bars shut, hard and loud onto the ground before you.
You squat down, grabbing the bar.
Without moving the bars at all, you feel your back breaking. Your spine...
In pain, but... perhaps now you've warmed it up.
The goblin, who has been glaring at your awful form, mutters, "Please don't."
Luckily, due to the horizontal bars, this actually does help.
Great job. Got yourself a fancy hammer.
As you hold it up, you... are confused.
As you hold it up, you get it confirmed. It is indeed...
The material. It is not great for a bludgeoning weapon.
It bounces off with a loud pang.
Absolutely no damage to the wall. And the reverberations cause your hands to shake.
You swing it at his head.
The hammer bounces off him with a loud pang.
The goblin steps back, a shocked expression on his face.
A warhammer that is completely useless.
I like it. Makes me feel dwarven.
It's like a... status symbol, right?
Oh well. Might intimidate someone at least?
